withColdMutation.reason: Private COLD wrapper retains the literal public aggregate dispatcher, callback audit collection and original full/user-settings/standalone-favorite/feature-flag/team/loop-contract writer choice. These writers prepare installed postimages before commit and publish through the shared native source boundary. TestScaleP21ColdPreferences, ColdTeam and ColdLoopContract compare original callback inputs, native output, canonical/search/audit rows and sinks, including no-op, merged/skipped canonical rows, odd-offset JSON timestamps, rollback, commit/admission/cancellation failure, HOT refresh, coordinator binding and retry. Fresh JSON timestamp receipts are audited before restoring native import inputs and released on retry/close. Loop forced-full and unintegrated issue/content writers are rejected before execution; general COLD routing and original consumer guards remain unchanged.
withColdMutation.temperatureReason: Trusted on-demand legacy mutation executor; HOT mutations use their existing bounded writers.
callers: Private COLD dispatcher boundary; currently targeted integration tests

withColdFullMutation.reason: Private original full-metadata-writer integration shares the replica COLD slot and parent write mutex, refreshes the installed base before mutation, binds the original physical default key before coordinator acquisition, prepares exact native source/policy before SQL commit and publishes before synchronous sinks. TestScaleP21ColdFullWrite covers native preimages, canonical rows, rollback after preparation and commit failure, malicious external changes, current-source sinks, HOT changes, peer conflict retries, coordinator/default races and exact/unknown stamps. SQL comparison is 11 legacy versus 12 COLD, a fixed one-query commit-stamp cost. Optimized and issue/content writers are rejected; this adds no general COLD routing or startup exemption.
withColdFullMutation.temperatureReason: On-demand full hydration is restricted to the private full-metadata COLD writer boundary; optimized/content writers remain independently guarded.
callers: Private COLD full metadata mutation boundary; currently targeted integration tests

installColdFullWriteLocked.reason: Transfers precommit-prepared native source and policy to the bounded parent under the shared writer lock without postcommit allocation or hydration. Parent retains policy only; original exact/unknown metadata-write proof controls the logical stamp, including the loop writer's unknown stamp. TestScaleP21ColdFullWrite, ColdPreferences, ColdTeam and ColdLoopContract check sink ordering, rollback, policy-only residency, same-version retry and commit-stamp distinctions.
installColdFullWriteLocked.temperatureReason: Only the private COLD full-writer publication hook installs this pre-admitted postimage.
